mapper.sql: select r.rule_id, r.site_code, r.rule_no, r.rule_type, r.rule_name, r.description, r.level, r.enabled, r.paused_at, r.owner_user_id, r.notify_enabled, r.notify_chat_id, r.notify_chat_name, as notify_chats, r.currency, r.config::text as config, r.version, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, u.email as owner_email, u.nick_name as owner_name, coalesce(u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0', false) as owner_valid, coalesce(ch.name, r.notify_chat_name) as chat_name, ch.status as chat_status, cu.email as create_by_email, mu.email as update_by_email from monitor_rule r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.owner_user_id left join sys_user cu on cu.user_name = r.create_by and cu.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user mu on mu.user_name = r.update_by and mu.del_flag = '0' left join monitor_lark_chat ch on ch.site_code = r.site_code and ch.chat_id = r.notify_chat_id
mapper.select: select r.rule_id, r.site_code, r.rule_no, r.rule_name, r.enabled, r.del_flag, r.version from monitor_rule r where r.rule_type = 'ORDER' and r.rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.update: update monitor_rule set owner_user_id = #{rule.ownerUserId}, rule_name = #{rule.ruleName}, description = #{rule.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, level = #{rule.level}, notify_enabled = #{rule.notifyEnabled}, notify_chat_id = #{rule.notifyChatId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, notify_chat_name = #{rule.notifyChatName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, notify_chats = coalesce(#{rule.notifyChats,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[]')::jsonb, currency = #{rule.currency}, config = #{rule.config}::jsonb, version = nextval('monitor_rule_version_seq'), update_by = #{rule.updateBy}, update_time = #{rule.updateTime}, edit_time = #{rule.updateTime}, edit_by = #{rule.updateBy} where rule_id = #{rule.ruleId} and site_code = #{scope.siteCode} and del_flag = '0' and rule_type = 'ORDER'
